name: Landon Greer
residence: Cody, Park County (born in Casper; he wrote that he had lived in Cody 26 years and in Wyoming 33 years; 2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
occupation: Co-owner, with his wife, of Quality Asphalt Paving, Inc. (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
education: Cody High School; University of Wyoming (degree not stated in the 2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
prior_offices: Cody City Council, eight years, including four as council president (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
background: In his 2024 WyoFile questionnaire, Landon Greer wrote that he lived in Cody, had lived there 26 years and in Wyoming 33 years, was born in Casper, and would be 41 on Election Day 2024. He wrote that he graduated from Cody High School and the University of Wyoming, is married to Evee, and that together they own Quality Asphalt Paving, Inc., which his father started in 1998. He said he served eight years on the Cody City Council, four of them as council president, and that they have eight children.
